description: This file defines the GoogleCalendarProvider class, which integrates SuiteCRM with Google Calendar via OAuth2. It manages authentication, calendar creation, event retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion, and converts between Google Calendar events and SuiteCRM calendar events.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarProvider
classes.description: A class that manages integration with Google Calendar, including OAuth authentication, calendar management, and event synchronization for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to Google Calendar and returns the result.

methods.name: testGoogleCalendarConnection
methods.description: Performs the actual connection test to Google Calendar API.

methods.name: initializeGoogleServices
methods.description: Initializes Google Client and Calendar Service objects.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves and refreshes OAuth access token as needed.

methods.name: getOAuthConnection
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth connection object linked to the calendar account.

methods.name: getOrCreateSuiteCRMCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the SuiteCRM calendar in Google Calendar.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events based on a query.

methods.name: convertFromGoogleEvent
methods.description: Converts a Google Event object into a SuiteCRM CalendarAccountEvent.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by ID.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event in Google Calendar.

methods.name: convertToGoogleEvent
methods.description: Converts a SuiteCRM CalendarAccountEvent into a Google Event object.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing Google Calendar event.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event from Google Calendar.
